verses.1: And he brought me into the room. He measured the sheep to be six cubits wide, and the goats to be six cubits wide as well.
verses.2: And the width of the entrance was ten amotes; and the height of the entrance was five amotes from the front. Its length was forty amas; and its width was twenty amas.
verses.3: And he came inside. The door was two cubits wide; the entrance itself was six cubits wide, and the width of the entire entrance was seven cubits.
verses.4: And he measured its length at forty cubits, and its width at forty cubits. He said to me, “This is the holy place of holies.”
verses.5: The width of the room was six amotes, and its depth was four amotes. It was spread out around the entire room.
verses.6: And the beams were arranged in groups of three, thirty times over. They were placed along the walls of the house, around each other, so that they wouldn’t overlap with each other.
verses.7: And it spreads out upwards, towards the top of the sides. When the house is turned upward, it spreads out around the house. In this way, the space inside the house expands upwards. And similarly, the lower part also rises up towards the upper part.
verses.8: And I saw that in the upper part of the house, around it, there were columns erected. They were six feet tall.
verses.9: The wall that extends from the side to the outside is five meters long. And there’s also a room on the side where the walls meet.
verses.10: And among the walls, there is a wide area of about forty amahs around the house.
verses.11: And there is one door for the entrance to the room. There’s also one door leading to the hallway. The area where the room is located is five cubits in diameter, around it.
verses.12: And the walls that are located in front of the sea are wide; their width is seventy amahs. The height of these walls is five amahs. Their length is also ninety amahs.
verses.13: And the length of the house was one hundred cubits, and its width and height were also one hundred cubits. Its walls were also one hundred cubits in length.
verses.14: And the area around the house and its surroundings was about a hundred acres in size.
verses.15: And the length of the building extended towards the front of the structure, along its sides. The interior walls and the outer walls were each about a hundred meters long.
verses.16: The closed and sealed areas, as well as the ancient ones, are all located around them. They face the steep walls of the trees that surround them. The land extends all the way to the open areas, and those open areas are covered with vegetation.
verses.17: On top of the door, and all around the inner room, as well as on all the walls around it. All around, inside and outside.
verses.18: And they were made into rods and sticks. There were also two sides to each rod.
verses.19: And the face of man towards the temple, and the face of Kefir towards the temple. They were made from wood, and they covered the entire house around it.
verses.20: From this land, all the way up to the entrance, there are walls and barriers.
verses.21: The temple is filled with smoke, and the face of the sacred place looks as it does.
verses.22: The altar was made of wood; it stood six cubits high, with its sides being two cubits long. Its edges were also made of wood. This altar was the place where God spoke to me. It stood in front of Jehovah’s throne.
verses.23: And two doors were made for the house and for the holy place.
verses.24: And two doors for its doors; two doors that are connected to each other. Two doors lead to one door, and two doors lead to the other side.
verses.25: And they made holes in the doors of the chambers, so that they could be opened and closed. They also made thick wood around the edges of the openings from the outside.
verses.26: And the hollows and crevices on its back, from one spot to another, along with its ribs and other parts of its body.
